title: 181. Simplify Path

examples.explanation: The trailing slash should be removed.
Multiple consecutive slashes are replaced by a single one.
A double period ".." refers to the directory up a level (the parent directory).
Going one level up from the root directory is not possible.
"..." is a valid name for a directory in this problem.

hints: Split by '/' and use a stack: ignore empty parts and '.', pop on '..' when possible, otherwise push the directory name.
Join the stack with '/' prefixed; return '/' when the stack is empty.
